title: Gully's year
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: Gully has a plan for the year: learn the tides by heart, all of them, no table. The uncle says nobody does that. Gully says he'll be the one. Wood draws him saying it and believes him.

panels.composition: The shack. GULLY with the tide table in one hand, not looking at it. The UNCLE on a crab pot. WOOD. BARNABY.

balloons.text: This year I learn 'em. No table.

image.prompt: inside a bait shack: a stocky teenager holding a tide table without looking at it, an old man on a crab pot, a young man and a small dog, black and white, no words
a stocky teenager in a backwards cap, plain and certain, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The uncle, looking at his nephew a beat longer than usual.

image.prompt: an old weathered man looking at a teenager for a long moment, unreadable, black and white, no words

panels.composition: Wood drawing Gully saying it. On the pad: Gully, the table held away from him, the line certain. Wood believes the drawing.

image.prompt: a young man drawing on a pad a stocky teenager holding a paper away from himself, the drawing confident, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: 'Then I'll be the one.' By 2003 he can. The strip believes him first.
